topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It provides introductory framing and outlines the learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Tumor viruses, proto-oncogenes, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: They trace how the historical study of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays for measuring cell transformation.

topics.label: Functional classifications and mechanisms of cancer genes
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the definitions and functional consequences of oncogenic and tumor-suppressive mutations through cell cycle regulation and gene dosage models.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: They contrast sequence and chromosomal instability by detailing the specific DNA repair failures and mitotic segregation defects that produce them.

topics.label: Multistep tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: They explore how somatic and inherited mutations drive tumor evolution over time and whether genetic instability is required throughout progression.

topics.label: Closing remarks and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture with recommended reading and an outlook on upcoming topics.
